features.feature: CHK-001 Inventory legacy Koala dev-memory entries and define supersession mapping

features.feature: CHK-002 Implement dev-memory supersession priority for preflight/search/list consumers
features.covered_by: Plan CHK-002 adds computed supersession metadata in core dev-memory, ranks current superseding entries ahead of superseded legacy entries, and annotates search/list/preflight formatting.

features.feature: CHK-003 Capture current Proofbound/Lattice superseding memories for legacy Koala lessons
features.covered_by: Plan CHK-003 appends current Proofbound/Lattice project memories citing legacy ids, keeps old global entries untouched/readable, and requires search/preflight to prefer current entries.

features.feature: CHK-004 Add smoke coverage for superseded dev-memory ordering and legacy terminology mapping
features.covered_by: Plan CHK-004 seeds legacy Koala plus current Proofbound/Lattice entries and verifies supersession projection, ordering, formatting, and non-authoritative legacy flags.
